name: Sohra
source:
Due to the loss of his family, Sohra often falls into depression and has developed a dependence on alcohol. Despite his struggles, he still cares deeply for others.

Little is known about Sohra’s past, except that he lost his family during the war against Beexen’s ghosts. By the beginning of The Beexen’s Tale, he is a member of the resistance movement opposing Beexen’s phantoms.
